reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence medium). No API for the pre-owned inventory site itself, but Mercedes-Benz /developers offers an official VIN-based Vehicle Specification API (decode_vin) on a commercial plan.

reason: No API for this used-car site: the site itself has no API; Mercedes-Benz's official Vehicle Specification (Fleet) API (https://developer.mercedes-benz.com/products/vehicle_specification, x-api-key, paid plan) decodes VINs and is served once, as automotive/mercedes_benz_gebrauchtwagen (decode_vin), since the same OEM API covers every Mercedes-Benz used-car site.
